shortDescription: Two people were killed, including a 6-year-old boy, and 11 hospitalized, after a truck drove through a soccer game in Wichita, Kansas, police said on Saturday.The other fatality was a 35-year-old man, while 10 of the injured had traumatic injuries believed to be non-life-threatening, police said.
